It's 김장 season in Korea ❄️🥬

김장 (gim-jang) = making kimchi for the whole winter, together
Best with warm boiled pork: 수육 (su-yuk)
Tasted something good? 맛있어요! (ma-si-sseo-yo) = It's delicious!

Kimjang is on UNESCO's Intangible Cultural Heritage list.
Have you ever tried fresh kimchi? Tell me 👇

In Korean, snow and eye are the same word ❄️👀

눈 (nun) = snow / eye
눈 + 사람 (person) = 눈사람 (nun-sa-ram) = snowman ☃️
눈 + 물 (water) = 눈물 (nun-mul) = tears

Got a word in your language that means two things? Tell me 👇

Korean friends won't just say your name 👋❄️

Name ends in a vowel → add 야 (ya): 하나 → 하나야!
Ends in a consonant → add 아 (a): 수진 → 수진아!
(It's casual — for friends.)

Comment your name and I'll show you how your Korean friends would call you 👇
